whyMatters.en: Pasadena hard-rock band formed in 1972. Two-handed tapping and high-gain midrange became a guitar-hero standard; the debut Van Halen (1978) is the main early citation.
whyMatters.zh: 帕萨迪纳 hard-rock 乐队，1972 年成立。双手 tapping 与高增益中频成为吉他英雄标准；同名首专 Van Halen（1978）是主要早期引用。

note.en: Tapping and harmonics showcase; guitar-hero practice reference.
note.zh: Tapping 与泛音展示；吉他英雄练习参照。

note.en: OBX synth riff plus hard-rock chorus; MTV mass single.
note.zh: OBX 合成器 riff 加 hard-rock 副歌；MTV 大众单曲。

note.en: 5150 opener; Hagar melodic range over Eddie keys.
note.zh: 5150 开场；Hagar 旋律音域盖在 Eddie 键盘上。

interviewQuotes.text: If I can do it, anybody can.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Eddie Van Halen

interviewQuotes.text: I am not a rock star. I am a rock singer.
interviewQuotes.speaker: David Lee Roth

shortBio.en: Eddie Van Halen–era hard rock; Eruption is the technique showcase; Roth and Hagar split the catalog.
shortBio.zh: Eddie Van Halen 时期 hard rock；Eruption 是技术展示；Roth 与 Hagar 分裂目录。

body.en:
Formed in 1972. The debut (1978, Ted Templeman) put Eddie’s tapping and brown-sound midrange beside Roth’s showman vocal and Anthony’s high harmonies. 1984 adds OBX synth hits. In 1985 Roth leaves and Hagar joins; 5150 opens a multi-platinum chapter.

Eruption remains the instrumental citation; Jump is the mass single; the singer swap is the chronicle structure.
body.zh:
1972 年组建。首专（1978，Ted Templeman）把 Eddie 的 tapping 与棕色中频，配上 Roth 表演人声与 Anthony 高和声。1984 加入 OBX 合成器热单。1985 年 Roth 离开、Hagar 加入；5150 打开多白金章节。

Eruption 仍是器乐引用；Jump 是大众单曲；主唱替换是编年史结构。

title.zh: Tapping 作为 hard-rock 练习标准

body.en:
Van Halen (1978) brings two-handed tapping, pinched harmonics, and high-gain midrange into hard-rock practice. Templeman keeps songs short; Roth sells carnival frontman energy.

Guitar-hero culture after 1978 cites this debut as a precision step beyond blues-rock defaults.
body.zh:
同名首专（1978）把双手 tapping、捏泛音与高增益中频带进 hard-rock 练习。Templeman 把歌唱短；Roth 卖马戏团主唱能量。

1978 后的吉他英雄文化把这张首专当作相对蓝调摇滚默认的精度一步。

title.zh: Roth 时期 vs Hagar 时期

body.en:
Peak chronicle silhouette: Roth / Eddie / Alex / Anthony (1978–85). In 1985 Hagar joins; 5150–Balance is the radio-metal chapter fans call Van Hagar. From 2007 Roth returns for reunion tours.

Same guitar core; two vocal approaches. Peak flag stays on the Roth-era classic.
body.zh:
编年史巅峰剪影：Roth / Eddie / Alex / Anthony（1978–85）。1985 Hagar 加入；5150–Balance 是粉丝称 Van Hagar 的电台金属章节。2007 年起 Roth 回归重聚巡演。

同一吉他内核；两套人声写法。巅峰旗留在 Roth 经典期。

body.en:
Eddie: Frankenstein guitar, MXR, Marshall mid. Alex: double-bass and ride accents. Roth: splits and spoken asides. Anthony: high stacked choruses that define the early mix.

That chemistry is hard to recreate; later casts show how loud the early mix was.
body.zh:
Eddie：Frankenstein 吉他、MXR、Marshall 中频。Alex：双底鼓与 ride 点缀。Roth：劈叉与旁白。Anthony：早期混音里的高叠副歌。

这套配合难以复刻；后来阵容可见早期混音有多响。

body.en:
Instrumental between You Really Got Me cover energy and Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love. Dive bombs, taps, tremolo abuse—cited across 80s shred practice.

Hard-rock albums rarely put a solo étude this central.
body.zh:
夹在 You Really Got Me 翻唱能量与 Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love 之间的器乐。俯冲击、tapping、颤臂滥用——80 年代 shred 练习必引。

Hard-rock 专辑很少把独奏练习曲放这么中心。

title.en: Jump: synth riff, still hard rock
title.zh: Jump：合成器 riff，仍是 hard rock

body.en:
OBX hook, Roth chorus, Eddie still solos. MTV and arenas both take it. Keys work as another riff voice inside hard rock.

1984 peak single before the singer swap.
body.zh:
OBX 钩子、Roth 副歌、Eddie 仍独奏。MTV 与体育场都接。键盘在 hard rock 里当另一把 riff 声部。

主唱替换前的 1984 峰值单曲。

title.zh: 吉他标准与主唱替换案例

body.en:
Technique influence is permanent. Catalog debate (Roth vs Hagar) is permanent too. Guns N' Roses and 80s LA hard rock inherit the high-gain precision expectation.

Chronicle value: gear method and lineup versioning under one name.
body.zh:
技术影响是永久的。目录争论（Roth vs Hagar）也是。Guns N' Roses 与 80 年代洛杉矶 hard rock 继承高增益精度预期。

编年史价值：一个名字下同时有装备方法与阵容版本化。

note.en: Debut through 1984; tapping and showman peak.
note.zh: 首专至 1984；tapping 与表演人峰值。

note.en: Melodic radio hard rock; Van Hagar catalog.
note.zh: 旋律电台 hard rock；Van Hagar 目录。

note.en: Tapping étude that reset guitar-hero expectations.
note.zh: 重置吉他英雄预期的 tapping 练习曲。

note.en: High-gain precision plus Roth/Hagar singer-swap as twin chronicle facts.
note.zh: 高增益精度加 Roth/Hagar 主唱替换，为双编年史事实。
